not_found.temple_university: A DNP quality-improvement poster appears in the university-wide Temple University Graduate Symposium program (April 17, 2026), but no School of Nursing event of its own was found. A university-wide graduate symposium is not an APP venue, so it is not listed.
not_found.university_of_pennsylvania_2023: A magazine article refers to the first DNP Project Showcase held 'in May' 2023 with no day given. Not listed, because no organizer page states the date.
not_found.university_of_illinois_chicago: Two older UIC event slugs now render the December 4, 2025 content. Those two editions were dropped rather than recorded on a reused page.
not_found.university_of_kansas: A 'Multiple Dimensions of Scholarship and Inquiry Symposium' is named on the KU page with no date; not listed.
not_found.valparaiso_university: A dedicated DNP Project Presentations page exists but both it and the related post refuse automated reading, so no date could be read.
not_found.university_of_florida: CLI Day is named as the DNP dissemination venue; the only date found is from 2016, outside the window.
